description: This file defines internal data classes, enums, and functions for notification forwarding policies, including filtering by package list, quiet hours, and rate limiting.

classes.name: NotificationForwardingPolicy
classes.description: Data class representing the policy settings for forwarding notifications, including enabled status, mode, package list, quiet hours, and rate limit.

classes.name: NotificationBurstLimiter
classes.description: Class providing rate limiting for notification events based on a sliding window.

methods.name: NotificationPackageFilterMode.fromRawValue
methods.description: Static method to parse a raw string into a corresponding NotificationPackageFilterMode enum value.

methods.name: NotificationForwardingPolicy.allowsPackage
methods.description: Checks if a given package is allowed based on the current policy mode and package set.

methods.name: NotificationForwardingPolicy.isWithinQuietHours
methods.description: Determines if the current time (or provided epoch ms) falls within the specified quiet hours.

methods.name: normalizeLocalHourMinute
methods.description: Normalizes a time string into 'HH:MM' format if valid.

methods.name: parseLocalHourMinute
methods.description: Parses a time string into total minutes from midnight.

methods.name: NotificationBurstLimiter.allow
methods.description: Determines if a notification event is allowed under the rate limit at the given timestamp.
